recipe.title: Assign classrooms for one high-school period
recipe.scenario: Three classes already meet in second period. Assign one suitable room to each class without double-booking a room. Prefer South Lab for Civics seminar because it is closer to the preceding class. This example does not select periods, assign teachers, account for student course conflicts, or build a weekly timetable.

field.name: class-names
field.description: Class labels in order: Chemistry lab, Digital design, Civics seminar.

field.name: room-names
field.description: Room labels in zero-based index order: North Lab, South Lab, Media Studio.

field.name: eligible-pairs
field.description: Flattened class and room index pairs after checking equipment, capacity, accessibility, and availability: 0,0; 0,1; 1,0; 1,2; 2,1; 2,2.

field.name: preferred-civics-room
field.description: Optional room index preferred for Civics seminar, without overriding suitability. South Lab is 1.

field.name: assigned-rooms
field.description: For a feasible plan, one room index per class in input order. The example preference yields 0,2,1.
